title: IREN Secures $363M in AI Server Financing from Wingspire
summary:
The computing infrastructure firm has arranged a new credit facility to expand its artificial intelligence capacity without issuing new shares to investors. IREN obtained $363M in equipment financing from Wingspire, using its current revenue-generating GPUs and multi-year customer contracts as collateral to fund further buildout.

Wingspire, a portfolio company of Blue Owl formerly known as Liberty Commercial Finance, recorded $700M in total volume throughout 2025. The lender maintains warehouse lending facilities provided by Bank of America and Wells Fargo and has completed several GPU-related deals this year.
